subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed SKILL.md diagnostics be accepted as a lint-only command for now, or must normal skills list/check, gateway status, and Web Skills surfaces also report skipped candidates before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The issue asks for no silent failures across normal CLI and Web surfaces, while the open PR currently centers on skills lint; automation should not choose the permanent diagnostic surface, path redaction, or warning-volume policy.

options.title: Require Normal-Surface Diagnostics
options.body: Treat loader/status/list/check/Web skipped-candidate reporting as required for closing this issue, with skills lint allowed as an additional helper.

options.title: Land Lint First, Track Follow-up
options.body: Accept a repaired skills lint implementation as a first phase, but keep or create a canonical follow-up for status/list/Web diagnostics.

options.title: Limit Scope To Lint
options.body: Declare a validation command sufficient for now and intentionally defer passive warnings in normal status or Web views.

recommendation.title: Require Normal-Surface Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat loader/status/list/check/Web skipped-candidate reporting as required for closing this issue, with skills lint allowed as an additional helper.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest visible history across the current loader/CLI/frontmatter paths and prior review context for this issue.
